simple.meaning: יָהַב (yâhab) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put ; imperatively (reflexive) come.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 33 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 11:3. Its contexts include family, family line, Torah, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָהַב (H3051).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: יָהַב (yâhab) / H3051 is traced through Genesis 11:3, Genesis 11:4, Genesis 11:7, Genesis 29:21 as a generated source-based concept entry.
